email_subject: Application - Marketing Manager, Community & Events at Kayzen
email_body:
Dear Sebastian,

I'm writing to apply for the Marketing Manager, Community & Events role at Kayzen. Your vision of democratising programmatic marketing resonates with me, and I'd love to bring my relationship-building and event experience to your team.

While my CV focuses on SEO and content, I've consistently built communities and organised events throughout my career. At Knowledge Experts, I supported client events and community initiatives for major brands like ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo. As a freelancer, I've organised webinars and workshops to connect with clients and partners. I thrive on creating meaningful experiences that turn into business opportunities.

I'm fluent in English, comfortable working remotely, and eager to learn the AdTech landscape. I'm confident I can help Kayzen become more visible and connected across key communities.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Sebastian,

I'm excited to apply for the Marketing Manager, Community & Events role at Kayzen. Your mission to democratise programmatic marketing through an AI-native DSP aligns perfectly with my passion for leveraging technology to connect people and drive growth. Although my background is in digital marketing with a focus on SEO and content, I've always gravitated toward community-building and event-driven engagement—skills I believe are central to this role.

In my current freelance work, I design and run websites that foster community interaction, such as mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and content strategies to engage a niche audience. At Episto, I collaborate with clients to create content that builds relationships and drives organic traffic. Previously, at Knowledge Experts, I supported the team in building digital workplace sites for major brands like ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo, which involved coordinating with stakeholders and ensuring seamless user experiences—experiences that required careful planning and execution akin to event management.

While I haven't held a formal event marketing title, I've organised and promoted webinars, workshops, and online gatherings to connect with clients and partners. I've also managed vendor relationships, budgets, and timelines for website projects, which has honed my project management and attention to detail. I'm fluent in English and comfortable working remotely, and I'm eager to immerse myself in the AdTech ecosystem to understand Kayzen's products and community.

I'm drawn to Kayzen's values of positivity, curiosity, collaboration, and ownership. I'm a proactive problem-solver who thrives in dynamic environments and enjoys turning challenges into opportunities. I'm confident that my relationship-building skills, project management experience, and enthusiasm for community engagement will allow me to contribute meaningfully to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can help Kayzen build a vibrant community and deliver impactful events.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok
